The command’s spokesperson, SP Nafiu Habib, disclosed this in a statement issued on Tuesday, detailing three separate operations carried out by Police operatives in the state.
According to the statement, operatives attached to the ‘D’ Division, Dutsen Tanshi, responded to a distress call on Monday along Old Airport Road in the Gidan Gona area of Bauchi, where three secondary school students were allegedly robbed.
Habib said one, Zakariya’u Musa, a 22-year-old of Unguwan Maikafi, Bauchi, alongside two accomplices identified as Abdul’aziz, also known as Carlos, and another suspect known as Jagwa, both from the Old Airport area, allegedly trailed the students, who were wearing their school uniforms and heading to school at BSADP.
He said the suspects lured the students into a passage, brought out a sharp knife and threatened to stab them before dispossessing them of their belongings.
The stolen items included a Tecno Spark 6 phone valued at N42,000 and a Lesia keypad phone valued at N8,000. “The courage and alertness of the students, who raised the alarm, led to the arrest of Zakariya’u Musa, while his two accomplices escaped,” the statement said.
The Police spokesperson added that a manhunt had been intensified to apprehend the fleeing suspects and bring them to justice.
In a separate incident, operatives attached to the ‘A’ Division, Township, Bauchi, arrested a 20-year-old suspect, Isa Moh’d, of Abujan Kwata, in connection with a case of culpable homicide.
Habib said the suspect allegedly stabbed one Salim Moh’d to death on 18 October 2026, following a misunderstanding between them.
He added that the suspect was tracked and arrested on 19 October 2026, and would be transferred to the State Criminal Investigation Department (SCID), Bauchi, for discreet investigation and prosecution.
Similarly, the command said its operatives arrested a 28-year-old woman, Sara Chikodi, of Bayan Gari, Bauchi, over alleged involvement in illicit drug trafficking.
Habib explained that the arrest followed credible intelligence received by the operatives as part of the command’s ongoing crackdown on illicit drugs.
“Upon search, ten (10) sachets of dry leaves suspected to be Colorado/Indian Hemp and one pinch of Methamphetamine, popularly known as Ice, were recovered from her,” the statement said.
He added that the case was under investigation, while efforts were ongoing to identify and arrest the suspect’s alleged supplier and dismantle the drug supply chain.
The Commissioner of Police, Bauchi State Command, CP Sani-Omolori Aliyu, commended the operatives for their gallantry and prompt response to the incidents.
He also appreciated members of the public for their cooperation and timely provision of information, assuring residents that the command remained committed to protecting lives and property.
The commissioner warned criminal elements to steer clear of the state, stressing that the command would sustain its efforts to make Bauchi uncomfortable for those engaging in criminal activities.
